# "Much to me" — ZZ Session 24.08.26 (private test material)

80 s of one song with three cameras, the mixed master and every instrument track,
all aligned to the same moment. 640x360, pixelated on purpose. Private repo only.

| File            | Source (RAWVideos/ZZSesions/2026/August/ZZS24.08.26)              | Excerpt          |
|-----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------|
| master.mp3      | edited/Audio/Refine/02 - Much to me_v1_20260925_153759.mp3        | 490.5–570.5 s    |
| cam-sony.mp4    | raw/video/Sony6000/C0186.MP4 (handheld Sony)                       | 2–95 s           |
| cam-fixed.mp4   | raw/video/Iphone/IMG_0043.MOV (fixed phone)                        | 400–495 s        |
| cam-360.mp4     | raw/video/360/Camera01/VID_20260824_203343_00_003.mp4 (equirect)   | 404–500 s        |
| stems/*.mp3     | raw/sound/24.08.26 ZZS Waves/*_1.wav (14 tracks)                   | 1305–1385 s      |

Alignment was measured by onset correlation against the overhead track (OV_1.wav),
every file agreeing in three separate windows: master 814.50 s, Sony 1298.29 s,
phone 899.63 s, 360 893.72 s into the session recording. The stems are exactly the
master's 80 s window; each camera starts a few seconds before it.
`viewpoints.json` holds sample 360 points of view (Stage, Drums, Guitar, Keys, Audience).
